notizie.titolo: AMLA Executive Board Member Derville Rowland attends Eurofi Financial Forum in Dublin
notizie.descrizione: AMLA Executive Board Member Derville Rowland participated in the panel discussion “AML and AMLA: From Policy to Action” at the Eurofi Financial Forum, held in Dublin from 16 to 19 September 2026.

notizie.titolo: Call for expression of interest: technology providers roundtable on partnerships for information sharing
notizie.descrizione: AMLA and the European Data Protection Board (EDPB) are inviting technology providers with practical experience of AML/CFT information-sharing arrangements to join an online roundtable on 30 November 2026.

notizie.titolo: AMLA Executive Board Member Derville Rowland meets EBF Financial Crime Strategic Group
notizie.descrizione: AMLA Executive Board Member Derville Rowland met with the European Banking Federation’s Financial Crime Strategic Group in Frankfurt on 22 October 2026, for an exchange on the development of the EU AML/CFT framework.

notizie.titolo: AMLA Executive Board Member Derville Rowland at Corporate Crime & Regulation Summit
notizie.descrizione: AMLA Executive Board Member Derville Rowland delivered a keynote speech at the A&L Goodbody Corporate Crime & Regulation Summit in Dublin on 14 October 2026.

notizie.titolo: Press Release: AMLA and OLAF strengthen cooperation in the fight against financial crime
notizie.descrizione: Press Release: AMLA and OLAF strengthen cooperation in the fight against financial crime

notizie.titolo: Hennie Verbeek-Kusters highlights the importance of prevention in AML/CFT at International Anti-Financial Crime Summit
notizie.descrizione: AMLA Executive Board Member Hennie Verbeek-Kusters delivered a keynote speech at the International Anti-Financial Crime Summit in London on 7 October 2026.

notizie.titolo: AMLA Executive Board Member Hennie Verbeek-Kusters speaks at IBSA Meeting in Brussels
notizie.descrizione: AMLA Executive Board Member Hennie Verbeek-Kusters delivered a presentation at the 83rd IBSA General Membership Meeting in Brussels on 14 September 2026.

notizie.titolo: AMLA identifies AML/CFT priorities for the review of MiCA
notizie.descrizione: The Authority for Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism (AMLA) today published its response to the European Commission's targeted consultation on the review of the Regulation on Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA).

notizie.titolo: AMLA Chair Bruna Szego in interview with Money Laundering Bulletin
notizie.descrizione: AMLA Chair Bruna Szego spoke to Money Laundering Bulletin, a specialist AML/CFT journal, about how AMLA is working towards greater convergence in the EU's fight against money laundering and terrorist financing.

notizie.titolo: Press Release: AMLA consults on draft standards for an EU-wide AML/CFT database
notizie.descrizione: AMLA is consulting, via a public hearing, on the draft regulatory technical standards (RTS) that will establish a central AML/CFT database.

notizie.titolo: AMLA Executive Board Member Hennie Verbeek-Kusters speaks at the 10th Austrian Anti-Money Laundering Conference in Vienna
notizie.descrizione: AMLA Executive Board Member Hennie Verbeek-Kusters delivered a keynote speech at the 10th Austrian Anti-Money Laundering Conference in Vienna on 1 October 2026.

notizie.titolo: AMLA Vice-Chair Juan Manuel Vega Serrano takes part in panel at Foro La Toja
notizie.descrizione: AMLA Vice-Chair Juan Manuel Vega Serrano took part in a panel discussion on organised crime at the Foro La Toja on 3 October 2026.

notizie.titolo: AMLA invites stakeholders to sectoral roundtables on simplified customer due diligence
notizie.descrizione: AMLA is inviting obliged entity representatives, trade associations and other representative bodies from the financial and non-financial sectors to express their interest in participating in sectoral roundtables on the application of simplified customer due diligence.

notizie.titolo: Press Release: AMLA finalises key standards for the private sector
notizie.descrizione: AMLA has finalised three sets of regulatory technical standards (RTS) defining key measures companies and professionals must apply to reduce money laundering and terrorist financing risks.

notizie.titolo: Press Release: AMLA finalises standards on Home-Host Supervisory Cooperation
notizie.descrizione: AMLA has published its final draft Regulatory Technical Standards (RTS) on the cooperation of home and host supervisors of cross-border groups.

notizie.titolo: AMLA takes next step toward 2027 selection of entities for direct supervision
notizie.descrizione: AMLA has published a reporting package for the identification of provisionally eligible obliged entities, a key preparatory step toward the first selection cycle for entities that will come under AMLA’s direct supervision from 2028.

notizie.titolo: AMLA Executive Board Member Simonas Krepšta addresses Global Conference on Criminal Finances and Cryptoassets in Luxembourg
notizie.descrizione: AMLA Executive Board Member Simonas Krepšta delivered a presentation at the 10th Global Conference on Criminal Finances and Cryptoassets in Luxembourg on 15 September 2026.

notizie.titolo: Connecting intelligence and supervision: Rikke-Louise Petersen speaks at Nordic Financial Crime & Sanctions Forum
notizie.descrizione: MLA Executive Board Member Rikke-Louise Petersen delivered the opening keynote at the Nordic Financial Crime & Sanctions Forum in Copenhagen on 15 September 2026.

notizie.titolo: AMLA launches survey on Central Contact Points
notizie.descrizione: Share your experience: AMLA is inviting Electronic Money Institutions (EMIs) and Payment Service Providers (PSPs) to provide feedback on their experience with the current Central Contact Point (CCP) framework pursuant to Article 45(9) AMLD and Delegated Regulation (EU) 2018/1108.

notizie.titolo: AMLA Chair Bruna Szego delivers speech at Central Bank of Montenegro 25th Anniversary Conference
notizie.descrizione: AMLA Chair Bruna Szego delivered a speech at the Central Bank of Montenegro's 25th Anniversary Conference in Tivat on 4 September 2026, in a session titled "Financial Integrity vs. Financial Innovation: Can Europe Have Both?"

notizie.titolo: EBA publishes draft reporting framework for the 2027 eligibility data collection
notizie.descrizione: As part of release 4.4 of its reporting framework, the European Banking Authority (EBA) has published a public working draft of the data model and taxonomy that will support the collection of data on eligibility for direct supervision by AMLA.

notizie.titolo: Press Release: AMLA finalises common formats for FIU cooperation and reporting to the EPPO
notizie.descrizione: AMLA has finalised three sets of standards that will help financial intelligence move across the EU faster and more consistently.

notizie.titolo: Frequently asked questions on the reporting package for identifying provisionally eligible entities
notizie.descrizione: AMLA has published a document answering the questions most frequently raised about the reporting package on the identification of provisionally eligible obliged entities.

notizie.titolo: Press Release: AMLA finalises standards for supervisory cooperation in direct supervision
notizie.descrizione: New standards set out how AMLA and national supervisors will cooperate to select and directly supervise some of the EU’s most significant cross-border financial institutions from 2028.

notizie.titolo: Updated taxonomy for the 2027 risk assessment data collection
notizie.descrizione: As part of its reporting framework release 4.3, the European Banking Authority (EBA) has published an updated version of the data model and taxonomy that will support the collection of data for AMLA's risk assessment of entities eligible for direct supervision.

notizie.titolo: AMLA Chair presents 2025 Consolidated Annual Activity Report to the European Parliament
notizie.descrizione: AMLA Chair Bruna Szego presented the Authority’s 2025 Consolidated Annual Activity Report at a public hearing of the European Parliament’s ECON and LIBE Committees.

notizie.titolo: Press Release: AMLA consults on harmonised risk assessments in the non-financial sector
notizie.descrizione: A shared methodology across the EU: AMLA is inviting views on draft rules that will determine how supervisors in every Member State assess money laundering and terrorism financing risks of businesses and professionals in the non-financial sector.

notizie.titolo: Press Release: AMLA introduces a common EU approach to enforcing anti-money laundering rules
notizie.descrizione: For the first time, supervisors across the EU will apply a harmonised, consistent approach to enforcing breaches of anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist-financing rules.

notizie.titolo: Press Release: AMLA concludes public hearing on draft guidelines on ongoing monitoring of business relationships
notizie.descrizione: On 2 July 2026, AMLA held a public hearing on the guidelines on ongoing monitoring of a business relationship, an important milestone in developing the EU's new AML/CFT framework and the risk-based approach.

notizie.titolo: Press Release: AMLA launches public consultation on common format for reporting suspicions
notizie.descrizione: A common reporting format for a united fight against financial crime: AMLA is inviting views on draft standards that harmonise how companies and professionals report suspicions across the EU.

notizie.titolo: Consultation via a public hearing on the draft RTS for establishing a central AML/CFT database
notizie.descrizione: AMLA welcomes contributions on the draft Regulatory Technical Standards for establishing a central AML/CFT database.

notizie.titolo: Consultation on the draft RTS on criteria for identifying business relationships, occasional and linked transactions and lower thresholds
notizie.descrizione: AMLA welcomes contributions on the draft Regulatory Technical Standards (RTS) on criteria for identifying business relationships, occasional and linked transactions and lower thresholds.

notizie.titolo: Consultation on the draft RTS on Customer Due Diligence
notizie.descrizione: AMLA welcomes contributions on the draft Regulatory Technical Standards (RTS) on Customer Due Diligence.

notizie.titolo: Consultation on the draft RTS on group-wide minimum requirements and additional measures for subsidiaries and branches in third countries
notizie.descrizione: AMLA welcomes contributions on the draft RTS on group-wide minimum requirements and additional measures for subsidiaries and branches in third countries

notizie.titolo: Consultation on the draft RTS on the assessment of the inherent and residual risk profile of obliged entities in the non-financial sector
notizie.descrizione: AMLA welcomes contributions on the draft Regulatory Technical Standards on the assessment of the inherent and residual risk profile of obliged entities in the non-financial sector.

notizie.titolo: Consultation on the draft RTS on pecuniary sanctions, administrative measures and periodic penalty payments
notizie.descrizione: AMLA welcomes contributions on the draft Regulatory Technical Standards (RTS) on pecuniary sanctions, administrative measures and periodic penalty payments.

notizie.titolo: Consultation on the draft RTS on cross-border information exchange between Financial Intelligence Units
notizie.descrizione: AMLA welcomes contributions on the draft Regulatory Technical Standards on cross-border information exchange between Financial Intelligence Units.

notizie.titolo: Consultation on the draft ITS on the format for reporting suspicions and providing transaction records
notizie.descrizione: AMLA welcomes contributions on the draft Implementing Technical Standards on the format for reporting suspicions and providing transaction records

notizie.descrizione: AMLA welcomes contributions on the draft Guidelines on ongoing monitoring of a business relationship

notizie.titolo: Consultation on the draft Guidelines on business-wide risk assessment
notizie.descrizione: AMLA welcomes contributions on the draft guidelines on business-wide risk assessment.

notizie.titolo: Consultation on the draft ITS under Art. 15(3) AMLAR
notizie.descrizione: AMLA welcomes contributions for the first public consultation launched on the draft ITS under Art. 15(3) AMLAR.
